sections.title: Full bike
sections.hint: Step back — whole bike in frame

sections.title: Contact points
sections.hint: Where the rider touches the bike

shots.title: Side profile
shots.prompt: Line both wheels up with the circles
shots.instruction: Stand square to the drive side with the camera at hub height. Both tyres should touch the ground line.
shots.check: Whole bike in frame, chain on the big ring, cranks level.

shots.title: Front three-quarter
shots.prompt: Fit the front wheel in the large oval
shots.instruction: Stand ahead of the front wheel, about 45° off the drive side, at chest height.
shots.check: Bars, fork and front wheel clearly visible.

shots.title: Rear three-quarter
shots.prompt: Fit the rear wheel in the large oval
shots.instruction: Stand behind the rear wheel, about 45° off the drive side, at chest height.
shots.check: Rear mech, cassette and saddle visible.

shots.title: Frame from above
shots.prompt: Saddle nose bottom-left, bars across the top
shots.instruction: Stand behind the saddle and shoot down along the top tube towards the bars.
shots.check: Top tube surface and both bar ends in frame.

shots.title: Shifter & brake lever
shots.prompt: Hood fills the top, lever down the middle
shots.instruction: Close up on the right-hand hood and lever from the side.
shots.check: Brand and model on the lever blade are readable; show any hood wear.

shots.title: Head tube & brand
shots.instruction: Close up on the head tube where the top and down tubes meet.
shots.check: Logo sharp, headset and fork crown visible.

shots.title: Fork & front tyre
shots.prompt: Fork leg on the diagonal, tyre label in the box
shots.instruction: Shoot down the fork leg to the axle with the tyre arc behind.
shots.check: Tyre make and size readable; rim decal visible.

shots.title: Top tube & stem
shots.prompt: Top tube across the middle, stem top right
shots.instruction: Side-on to the top tube with the stem and spacers in the top right.
shots.check: Top tube surface free of glare; stem bolts visible.

shots.title: Down tube
shots.prompt: Down tube level across the middle
shots.instruction: Shoot the down tube side-on so it runs level across the frame.
shots.check: Decals readable; show any chips on the underside.

shots.title: Seat cluster
shots.prompt: Seatpost down from the top, clamp in the box
shots.instruction: Close up where the seatpost, top tube and seat stays meet.
shots.check: Clamp area sharp — this is where cracks show first.

shots.title: Seat tube & model name
shots.instruction: From behind and slightly to the side, shoot the seat tube with the top tube running up to the bars.

shots.title: Drivetrain overview
shots.prompt: Cassette left circle, chainring right circle
shots.instruction: Side-on at crank height with the rear wheel on the left.
shots.check: Both derailleurs, chain and chainring in frame.

shots.title: Rear mech & cassette
shots.prompt: Cassette in the circle, mech below
shots.instruction: Close up on the rear derailleur and cassette at axle height.
shots.check: Cassette teeth and mech cage in focus; show any scuffs.

shots.title: Chainset & front mech
shots.prompt: Chainring in the oval, crank to the right
shots.instruction: Close up on the chainset with the crank arm pointing forward.
shots.check: Chainring teeth and crank branding readable.

shots.title: Cockpit
shots.prompt: Bars across the middle, stem straight down
shots.instruction: Stand over the top tube and shoot straight down at the bars and stem.
shots.check: Both hoods and bar tape visible; bars straight.

shots.title: Saddle & seatpost
shots.prompt: Saddle on the diagonal, post down the middle
shots.instruction: Shoot the saddle from the side and slightly above.
shots.check: Show the saddle cover and any tears or scuffs.

shots.title: Front disc brake
shots.prompt: Rotor in the circle, fork from the left
shots.instruction: Go to the non-drive side and shoot straight at the front rotor.
shots.check: Rotor surface and caliper in focus.

shots.title: Rear disc brake
shots.prompt: Rotor in the circle, stays below
shots.instruction: Non-drive side, shoot straight at the rear rotor and caliper.
shots.check: Rotor surface and caliper in focus.
